name: Ricardo Sepúlveda
bio:
Ricardo's career began in law enforcement, where he spent over a decade honing his skills in risk assessment and security protocols. His transition into motorsport came unexpectedly when a chance encounter with a team owner led to a security consultancy role during a particularly turbulent season. He quickly proved his worth, implementing robust security measures that not only protected assets but also fostered a safer environment for the team. 

Ricardo's approach to security is both proactive and pragmatic. He believes in identifying potential threats before they materialize, relying on meticulous planning and a deep understanding of human behavior. What sets Ricardo apart is his ability to blend his law enforcement background with the fast-paced, high-stakes world of racing. He's not just about preventing breaches; he's about creating a secure environment where the team can focus on performance without distraction.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Ricardo is a man of medium build with a serious demeanor and watchful eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously documenting observations.
Has a habit of adjusting his tie, even when he isn't wearing one.
Insists on a thorough security briefing before any team event, no matter how small.
